scripts.build: npm run generate -w backend && npm run build -w contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run generate -w backend && npm run build -w contracts && npm run check --workspaces && npm run lint && npm run validate -w backend && node scripts/verify-design.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build -w contracts && npm run generate -w backend && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
